headwords: đàn ông xây nhà, đàn bà xây tổ ấm

flags.why: This name for cashew is used mainly in Southern Vietnamese ([regional usage](https://tamviet.net.vn/blogs/news/vi-sao-goi-qua-dieu-la-qua-dao-lon-hot)).
Learners are most likely to encounter the everyday gold-digging sense first ([dictionary entry](https://tudientv.com/?t=%C4%91%C3%A0o+m%E1%BB%8F)).
Calling someone đào mỏ is derogatory, as the dictionary's explicit contempt warning confirms ([dictionary entry](https://tudientv.com/?t=%C4%91%C3%A0o+m%E1%BB%8F)).
The expression contains the vulgar verb đái, which informal alone does not adequately warn about.
Ai bảo cậu không chịu học bài is a rhetorical rebuke for failing to study, rather than a question about who instructed the person not to study.
flags.fix: Serves you right—that's what you get for not studying.
